name: What is the process for getting custom shelving designed and installed?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting custom shelving designed and installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for custom shelving begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, storage needs, and the specific space. We then provide design recommendations and a detailed proposal, often including sketches or renderings. Once the design is approved, we source the necessary materials. Fabrication occurs either on-site or in our workshop. Finally, our skilled team meticulously installs the shelving, ensuring it fits perfectly and meets all structural and aesthetic requirements, followed by a final walkthrough for your approval.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial consultation, design recommendations and proposal, material sourcing, fabrication, and professional installation, concluding with your final approval.
